goblinlabour.ring.hint1: Right-click: call a mining crew or send it home
goblinlabour.ring.expired: Time's up, the goblins go home.
goblinlabour.ring.no_room: No room for the goblins here.
goblinlabour.blank.name: Goblin: %s
goblinlabour.bed.empty: This bed is empty. Right-click it with a Goblin Blank.
goblinlabour.job.collect.tooltip: Pick up loose items within the radius and bring them to the goblin chests. Collectors carry a backpack: twice the storage.
goblinlabour.job.rest.tooltip: Stay home: wander about the flat and nap in bed. Heals.
goblinlabour.job.mine_down.tooltip: Dig a shaft straight down outside the home
goblinlabour.job.mine_ahead.tooltip: Dig a tunnel away from the home
goblinlabour.job.mine_up.tooltip: Dig a shaft straight up (staff order)
goblinlabour.job.chop.tooltip: Fell trees within the radius, pick up the logs and replant saplings. Needs an axe for most logs.
goblinlabour.job.farm.tooltip: Works with the tools in its tool row. Hoe: harvest and replant crops, cocoa, berries, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus. Bucket: milk cows into a Milk Can at home. Shears: shear sheep. Treetap: tap rubber trees.
goblinlabour.staff.hint2: Right-click floor, ceiling or wall to dig
goblinlabour.staff.hint4: Left-click a chest to make it theirs
goblinlabour.staff.select_first: Pick some goblins first (left-click them with the staff).
goblinlabour.staff.chest_assigned: %s goblin(s) will unload into this chest.
goblinlabour.staff.chest_cleared: %s goblin(s) go back to the chests at home.
goblinlabour.staff.chest_too_far: That chest is too far from %s's bed (48 blocks at most).
gui.goblinlabour.staff.size.tooltip: Footprint of the shaft: 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 blocks around the clicked block.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.height.tooltip: Tunnel height. 1: only the clicked row. 2 or more: the floor is one block below the clicked block, so look straight ahead at the wall and click.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.target.tooltip: The shaft ends at this height (Y). Type a number or use the button next to it.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.bedrock.tooltip: Dig all the way down to bedrock.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.surface.tooltip: Dig up until the shaft reaches open sky.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.start.tooltip: Send every picked goblin to work on this order.
gui.goblinlabour.radius.tooltip: Work radius around the bed in blocks. Chop, Farm and Collect only look for trees, crops and items inside it.
gui.goblinlabour.width.tooltip: Tunnel width in blocks, centred on the clicked block.
gui.goblinlabour.length.tooltip: How far the tunnel goes into the wall. 16 blocks are one chunk.
gui.goblinlabour.stairs.tooltip: Build a cobblestone stair along the shaft wall so you can walk in and out.
gui.goblinlabour.replant.tooltip: Plant a sapling where a felled tree stood, from the saplings picked up under the tree. Saplings in the tool row are planted 3 to 6 blocks apart inside the radius. All else goes into the chests.
gui.goblinlabour.direction.tooltip: Which side of the home the work area lies on
gui.goblinlabour.churn_input.hint: A milk bucket is poured in, an empty bucket is filled. Both come out below.
gui.goblinlabour.tool_slot.hint: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe or sword; saplings for a lumberjack; bucket, shears, treetap or cocoa beans for a farmer. Tools never wear out here.
gui.goblinlabour.ring_book_slot.hint: Enchanted books: their enchantments go onto the crew's tools, e.g. Efficiency and Fortune.
gui.goblinlabour.backpack_slot.hint: Collectors carry twice as much loot.
gui.goblinlabour.backpack_slot.closed: Only collectors fill the backpack. Take out what is left.
goblinlabour.status.no_exit: no way out of the home
goblinlabour.book.start.text: Goblins dig, chop, farm and collect for you. Each one lives in a straw bed, works from there and calls for help in chat.
goblinlabour.book.start.step1: Craft rotten flesh into a Goblin Meat Pack and smelt it into a Goblin Blank.
goblinlabour.book.start.step2: Put a Goblin Straw Bed down and right-click it with the blank: a goblin moves in.
goblinlabour.book.start.step3: Right-click the goblin and give it tools.
goblinlabour.book.start.step4: Put a Goblin Chest near the bed, then right-click the bed and pick a job.
goblinlabour.book.start.recipe: A new guide: a book and rotten flesh.
goblinlabour.book.blank.text: A goblin that is not awake yet. A straw bed wakes it, and it keeps its name for good.
goblinlabour.book.blank.smelt: Smelt or smoke the Goblin Meat Pack into a Goblin Blank.
goblinlabour.book.blank.use: Right-click a Goblin Straw Bed with the blank: a goblin with a name of its own moves in.
goblinlabour.book.blank.back: Break the bed and the goblin goes back into its blank, name and tools included.
goblinlabour.book.bed.text: Where a goblin lives and works from. It is a block and a half long: the block at its foot end has to be free.
goblinlabour.book.bed.use: Right-click the bed to pick its goblin's job and the radius around the bed. What lies under the frame shows the job.
goblinlabour.book.bed.bunk: A bed on a bed makes a bunk bed. The upper goblin climbs in from the ground.
goblinlabour.book.bed.home: Around every bed lies a home of %s x %s x %s blocks. Goblins never dig there. Homes that touch each other become one.
goblinlabour.book.chest.text: Goblins unload into the Goblin Chests of their home, and into no other chest. No room left: they lie down and complain.
goblinlabour.book.chest.motto: "No room left for my loot. Empty the chests!"
goblinlabour.book.chest.use: Put it into a home. Two side by side make a double chest. A pickaxe mines it fastest.
goblinlabour.book.chest.dye: A dye paints a chest in its colour, green dye makes it plain again. Only chests of one colour join. Goblins fill them all.
goblinlabour.book.head.text: A goblin's head on a torch. It shows where the homes end.
goblinlabour.book.head.motto: "There's no way out of our home. Open a door for me!"
goblinlabour.book.head.use: Hold the head: the borders of the homes around you show as floating emeralds.
goblinlabour.book.staff.text: The staff picks goblins and sends them to dig shafts and tunnels.
goblinlabour.book.staff.use: Left-click goblins to pick them. They glow and follow you.
goblinlabour.book.staff.order: Right-click a block: floor = dig down, ceiling = dig up, wall = tunnel. Sneak + right-click opens the settings first.
goblinlabour.book.staff.defaults: Unless set otherwise: a %s x %s shaft with stairs, down to bedrock or up to the surface. Tunnels are %s wide, %s high and %s long.
goblinlabour.book.staff.tunnel: Tunnels 2 or more high start one block below the click. Height 1 digs that row only.
goblinlabour.book.staff.share: Picked goblins share one order and go back to their job when it is done.
goblinlabour.book.staff.chest: Left-click a chest with goblins picked: they unload there from now on, at most %s blocks from the bed. The same click again takes it back.
goblinlabour.book.ring.text: Calls a crew of %s goblins. They mine the ores within %s blocks of you for %s minutes and pick up items.
goblinlabour.book.ring.use: Right-click calls the crew, right-click again sends it home. Sneak + right-click opens the ring: it holds the loot.
goblinlabour.book.ring.vein: A vein is mined out completely, hidden ores too.
goblinlabour.book.ring.assist: Dig stone or earth yourself: they help, never below your feet.
goblinlabour.book.ring.staff: Picked with the staff they follow you. A staff order takes them off the leash until it is done.
goblinlabour.book.ring.books: Enchanted books in the ring's two slots enchant the crew's tools.
goblinlabour.book.ring.chest: A goblin chest within %s blocks: one goblin carries the loot over.
goblinlabour.book.can.text: An old milk can for %s buckets of milk. Farmers with a bucket fill it.
goblinlabour.book.can.use: Right-click with a milk bucket to pour it in, with an empty bucket to fill it, with an empty hand for its screen.
goblinlabour.book.can.level: The milk shows at the rim; a full can has its lid on. Broken, it keeps its milk.
goblinlabour.book.can.hopper: Hoppers put buckets in from the top and the sides and take them out below. A comparator reads the level.
goblinlabour.book.expansion.text: A tank for %s buckets of milk. A Milk Can standing on it pours its milk down into it.
goblinlabour.book.expansion.use: It works like the can: buckets, an empty hand for its screen, hoppers and a comparator. Broken, it keeps its milk.
goblinlabour.book.expansion.pipes: Pipes and storage mods like Refined Storage take the milk out, or put it in, from every side.
goblinlabour.book.jobs.text: Right-click a bed to pick a job and the radius around the bed. Everything goblins bring home goes into the goblin chests.
goblinlabour.book.jobs.chop: Chop: fells one tree at a time, from the lowest log up, and replants. Hacks through leaves, climbs scaffold.
goblinlabour.book.jobs.saplings: Saplings in its tool row are planted out, at least %s blocks apart.
goblinlabour.book.jobs.farm: Farm: works with the tools in its tool row, see Farming.
goblinlabour.book.jobs.collect: Collect: picks up loose items and carries twice as much.
goblinlabour.book.farming.text: A farmer does whatever its tool row has tools for, the nearest thing first.
goblinlabour.book.farming.hoe: Hoe: harvests and replants crops, cocoa, sweet and glow berries, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus.
goblinlabour.book.farming.nohoe: Without a hoe ripe crops stay, and the farmer asks for one.
goblinlabour.book.farming.cocoa: Cocoa beans in the tool row are planted on jungle logs.
goblinlabour.book.farming.bucket: Bucket: milks cows, each one every %s minutes. The milk goes into a Milk Can at home.
goblinlabour.book.farming.treetap: Treetap (Tech Reborn): taps rubber trees for sap.
goblinlabour.book.tools.text: Goblins only use the tools they carry. Without a pickaxe they break no stone.
goblinlabour.book.tools.motto: "I can't dig through this with my bare hands. Give me a pickaxe!"
goblinlabour.book.tools.row: Right-click a goblin for its inventory. Tools go into the tool row and never wear out.
goblinlabour.book.tools.torch: Goblins place free torches and plug lava and water with cobblestone.
goblinlabour.book.tools.scaffold: Goblin Scaffold takes them up to high logs and out of pits. It vanishes %s minutes after the last goblin used it.
goblinlabour.book.tools.death: Lava, drowning and falls kill goblins.
goblinlabour.book.tools.respawn: A dead goblin respawns at its bed with its tools. Its loot drops where it died, and it walks back for it.
